entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ennio Quirino Visconti was a Roman politician, antiquarian, and art historian, papal Prefect of Antiquities, and the leading expert of his day in the field of ancient Roman sculpture. His son, Pietro Ercole Visconti, edited Versi di Ennio Quirino Visconti, raccolti per cura di Pietro Visconti while Louis Visconti became a noted architect in France. His brother, Filippo Aurelio Visconti, was also a classical scholar, who published the Museo Chiaramonti, a successor to the Museo Pio-Clementino.
